game.title: SIGNAL // NOISE
game.subtitle: An 18-card asymmetric relay & interference game
game.summary: Keep the emergency telemetry bus alive until Dawn, or flood the frequency with static before the final checksum clears.
setup: Separate the 5 Role cards (SYS-01 to SYS-05). Shuffle them and deal 1 face-down to each player; return unused Roles to the box without looking.
Shuffle the remaining 13 Action cards (Relays, Interference, Overrides) to form the Transmission Stack.
Deal 2 Action cards to each player as their starting hand. Set a 6-tick Dawn track beside the stack starting at Tick 0.

turnSteps.detail: Draw 1 card from the Transmission Stack. If the stack is empty, shuffle the Burn pile into a fresh stack and advance Dawn by 1.
Play 1 card from hand face-up (or face-down if Spoofed Packet) onto the table bus, paying its Bandwidth cost by discarding cards equal to Cost - 1, or pass to draw 1 extra card.
Apply the card's effect, resolve any reaction window, and advance the Dawn counter by 1 tick unless an effect alters the clock.

winConditions.condition: Total active Signal Power on the table reaches 8 or higher when Tick 6 concludes.
Active Interference + Noise bursts equal or exceed Signal Power at Tick 6, OR 3 Relays are locked down simultaneously.
The Dead-Drop Courier wins alone if both Signal Relays and Noise Bursts finish with exactly 2 active cards each.

printNotes: Print at 100% (Actual Size) — never use 'Fit to Page' or 'Shrink Oversized Pages'.
For double-sided printing, select Duplex: Flip on Long Edge. Backs on pages 2 and 4 are mirrored 3-2-1 to match fronts.
Cut along the outer hairline crop marks after printing; each trimmed card measures 2.25 x 3.125 in (57 x 79 mm).
playtestFocus: Does the Bandwidth discard cost on 3-cost cards feel fair in 3-player games?
Is the Dead-Drop Courier win condition achievable without table-talk giveaways?
Check duplex alignment between page 1 and page 2 on your home printer.

cards.name: Relay Operator
cards.ability: Once per round, inspect the top 2 cards of the Stack. Keep 1 Relay or Override; bury the other face-down.
cards.flavor: Keep the carrier clean until sunrise.

cards.name: Spectrum Analyst
cards.ability: Peek at one neighbor's face-down card on the table without revealing it to other players.
cards.flavor: Every spike leaves a harmonic fingerprint.

cards.name: Static Saboteur
cards.ability: When the Dawn clock hits Tick 3, secretly swap 1 active Relay with any card in the Burn pile.
cards.flavor: Dead air is just an uncontested channel.

cards.name: Echo Broker
cards.ability: Once per game, copy the most recently played Interference card as if you played it from hand.
cards.flavor: Repeat a lie on three bands and it becomes telemetry.

cards.name: Dead-Drop Courier
cards.ability: Win alone at Dawn if exactly 2 Signal Relays and 2 Noise Bursts remain active on the bus.
cards.flavor: Neither side owns the courier's frequency.

cards.name: Uplink Beacon
cards.ability: Lock onto the main bus. Contributes +2 Signal Power toward the Dawn threshold.

cards.name: Carrier Wave
cards.ability: Cannot be cancelled by Static Burst if another Signal Relay is already locked on the bus.
cards.flavor: Steady amplitude cuts through heavy weather.

cards.name: Checksum Gate
cards.ability: Draw 1 card when this Relay resolves. Reveal any 1 card currently in the Burn pile.
cards.flavor: Every frame arrives signed or discarded.

cards.name: Phase Filter
cards.ability: Purge 1 active Interference card from the table into the Burn pile, then lock this Relay.
cards.flavor: Notch out the hum, keep the voice.

cards.name: Burst Repeater
cards.ability: Each adjacent Relay on the bus gains +1 Signal Power while this Repeater stays online.
cards.flavor: Weak signal amplified across three towers.

cards.name: Coldline Bridge
cards.ability: Discard 1 card from hand when played to lock immediately without opening a reaction window.

cards.name: Static Burst
cards.ability: Cancel a Relay played this turn unless its sender discards 1 extra card from hand.

cards.name: Spoofed Packet
cards.ability: Play face-down claiming it is a Relay. Flip when audited or at Dawn to cancel +2 Signal.

cards.name: Clock Drift
cards.ability: Reverse play order around the table and advance the Dawn counter by 1 extra tick.
cards.flavor: Two lost milliseconds break every handshake.

cards.name: Blackout Fuse
cards.ability: Lock down the highest-power active Relay on the table; its Signal Power drops to 0.
cards.flavor: Cut the breaker before the frame completes.

cards.name: Hard Reboot
cards.ability: All players pass 1 card face-down to the left. Clear all lockdown tokens on Relays.
cards.flavor: Flush the buffer and trust nobody's cache.

cards.name: Parity Audit
cards.ability: Target player must reveal either their hidden Role card or all cards remaining in their hand.
cards.flavor: Show your checksum or surrender the frame.

cards.name: Emergency Patch
cards.ability: Recover 1 Relay card from the Burn pile into your hand and immediately end your turn.
cards.flavor: Soldered in the dark with thirty seconds left.
